title: GEO panel comparability warning threshold profile
description: Optional GEO panel warning cutoffs and selected warning-code gate policy. Omitted numeric thresholds use the CLI defaults.

contextShareShiftPp.description: Warn when a nonzero context observation-share shift reaches this many percentage points.

contextMixTotalVariationPp.description: Warn when observation-mix total variation reaches this many percentage points; zero warns on any nonzero drift.

promptMixTotalVariationPp.description: Warn when unique prompt-group mix total variation reaches this many percentage points; zero warns on any nonzero drift.

promptJaccardPctBelow.description: Warn when any matched context prompt-set Jaccard falls below this percentage.

incompleteListPctAbove.description: Warn when a context has a greater incomplete citation-list percentage.

singleCapturePromptPctAbove.description: Warn when any context has a greater share of prompts with one capture.

contextDimensionCoveragePctBelow.description: Warn when any optional context dimension has a lower coverage percentage.

minimumMatchedPrompts.description: Warn when a matched context has fewer shared exact prompts.

duplicateCapturePctAbove.description: Warn when either panel has a greater exact-duplicate capture percentage; zero preserves the default warning on any duplicate.

captureWindowGapDaysAbove.description: Warn when any exact-context baseline/current capture-window gap is greater than this number of days; zero warns on any nonzero gap.

largestPromptCaptureSharePctAbove.description: Warn when any context has a greater share of captures attributable to its most repeated exact prompt.

maximumInternalCaptureGapDaysAbove.description: Warn when any exact context has a gap between distinct capture timestamps inside a panel that exceeds this number of days.

failOnWarningCodes.description: Optional warning codes that should fail the preflight after reports are written when present.
